findings.body: When an external package tries to use the newly exported `Framework` API, it cannot supply a transport because the field is unexported and no constructor exists. The only value callers can create is `Framework{}`, whose `Fetch` method panics at `framework.transport.Fetch()`; expose a constructor or field, or keep this type unexported if it is only an implementation detail.
findings.title: Provide a usable way to initialize Framework
